_comment: skills-lock.json — pinned skill sources for bob-cloud-architect.
A skill is a SKILL.md file that Bob loads via use_skill. It can come from any source.
This file records where each installed skill came from and what version/commit was
vendored, so the workspace is reproducible and auditable.
1. Obtain the SKILL.md by one of these methods:
a) Community registry (npx):  npx github:<org>/<repo>  (if the repo exports a skill)
c) Manual copy:               paste the SKILL.md content into .bob/skills/<name>/SKILL.md
d) Write your own:            create .bob/skills/<name>/SKILL.md from scratch
2. Register it in AGENTS.md (Skills available table).
3. Add an entry to this file with source, type, and the commit/version pinned.
4. Open a PR — skill changes are reviewed like code.
To update a skill: obtain the new SKILL.md, replace the file, update the entry below, PR.
Never edit a third-party skill file in place — replace it from its source and update the pin.

cloud-architecture-patterns.description: Pattern catalog for enterprise cloud architecture — event-driven, CQRS, saga, structural, and data patterns with cloud-native service mappings for AWS, Azure, and GCP.

data-architecture-patterns.description: Generic data-platform guidance: store selection, medallion layering, open table formats and catalogs, streaming ingestion selection, data mesh, governance, and residency across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

genai-architecture.description: Planning-level generative-AI architecture: pattern selection, model access, RAG, agents, safety, evaluation, cost and reliability across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

iac-and-delivery-planning.description: Planning-level IaC and CI/CD guidance: tool selection (Terraform, OpenTofu, native), state and environment strategy, policy-as-code, landing zones, OIDC pipelines and supply-chain controls. No implementation code.

well-architected-review.description: Structured five-pillar architecture review (plus optional Sustainability) mapped to the AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Well-Architected Frameworks.

document-processing-profile.description: Architecture profile for enterprise document-processing pipelines: ingest, validate, batch, LLM summarisation, Snowflake/Databricks/Iceberg integration, reconciliation ledger, and CCL adapter.
